name: Zhike Peng
bio: I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Computer Science and Technology at Tsinghua University, advised by Professor Jing Chen. I received my bachelor's degree in Information and Computing Science from Tsinghua's Zhili College in 2026.
interests: My interests span theoretical computer science and artificial intelligence, with a particular focus on mechanism design and blockchain. I am also interested in graph theory, reinforcement learning theory, and world models.

researchAreas.title: Algorithms & incentives
researchAreas.text: Designing mechanisms for automated market makers, with attention to incentives and economic efficiency.

researchAreas.title: Learning & intelligence
researchAreas.text: Exploring reinforcement learning for language-model tool use, alongside broader interests in learning theory and world models.

researchAreas.title: Visual understanding
researchAreas.text: Studying automatic camera selection, scene representations, and the reconstruction of images from brain signals.

publications.title: Uniform-Price Mechanism Design for Automated Market Makers
publications.summary: A uniform-price batch auction for automated market makers, studying the trade-off between incentive guarantees and trading volume.

publications.title: ScenePhotographer: Object-Oriented Photography for Residential Scenes
publications.summary: An object-oriented framework that groups scene objects, proposes camera views, and selects informative compositions for residential scenes.

research.title: Uniform-price mechanism design for automated market makers
research.description: Designed uniform-price mechanisms for automated market makers and analyzed their economic properties and social efficiency.

research.title: Disentangling visual scene representations
research.description: Combined 3D VAEs and Slot Attention to investigate representation learning, feature disentanglement, and semantic segmentation in 3D scenes.

research.title: Image reconstruction from EEG signals
research.description: Explored reconstructing visual images from EEG signals using VQGAN and GPT.

research.title: Automatic viewpoint selection in 3D scenes
research.description: Studied automatic camera selection in virtual 3D scenes using object relationships, scene information, and composition criteria. Received the SRT Outstanding Project Second Prize.

industry.title: Machine Learning
industry.description: Worked on fundamental AI algorithms and AI product development, including algorithm design, experimental validation, and product exploration.

industry.title: Large Language Model Research
industry.description: Investigated reinforcement learning to improve multi-turn tool use in large language models, with experiments on training and evaluation.
